scope: Read-only source audit after image provenance fix; no paid generation/edit calls.

usage_ledger.image_relay_entries: No _record_usage call in OpenAIImageProvider; historical image HTTP attempts not reconstructable from ledger.
usage_ledger.fal_entries: SUBMITTED recorded before POST; response request_id and final status are not attached to the ledger entry.

generation_retries.relay_generate_fallback: One alternate-model request on any 400/404/422, not only explicit unknown-model response.
generation_retries.standard_views: Four independent concurrent edits; successful views retained, failures summarized; repeating action submits all four again.
generation_retries.ui_duplicate_submit_risk: Confirmation button lacks busy disabled and run() lacks busy guard; repeated clicks can overlap standard-view submissions.
generation_retries.backend_idempotency: No idempotency key/in-flight deduplication for Character image endpoints.

historical_leon_count.interpretation: Two CharacterAssetService generation invocations observed. Exact external HTTP count cannot be proven because pre-fix relay request IDs and ledger entries were not retained; alternate-model fallback may add an attempt.

provenance_fix.external_request_id: Now uses body request_id/id or x-request-id/request-id response header.
provenance_fix.model: Now records relay-returned model when present.
provenance_fix.image_dimensions: Now retains returned width/height when supplied, and requested size plus requested/submitted/actual aspect separately.
provenance_fix.credentials: Partial relay config fails locally rather than routing to Fal.
